title: Add St Andrew's cross braces to the tier-A gable
where: north and south tier-A gable faces, plane z=3 / z=13, x=4..8, y=9..11
instruction: In build.mjs add two diagonal runs of stripped_spruce_log (axis x) per gable face from the lower corners to the apex so they cross in an X, then mcd check.

title: Carve dragon eyes and teeth
where: the 8 dragon heads: x=3 and x=9 at z=1 y=11..12 and z=3 y=15..16; mirrored at z=15 / z=13
instruction: Edit dragon() in build.mjs: add polished_blackstone_button eyes on the side faces of the brow stair (needs a solid cell behind) and a second spruce_fence tooth under the snout; render --closeups to confirm the heads read.

title: Door portal surround
where: north nave wall z=3, door at x=6, y=2..4
instruction: Run mcd paint with `north rows 2-4 openings -> surround timber` (or call surround() with preset 'arch') so the door gets an arched head and jambs; keep the lanterns.

title: Carved portal sign legible from the steps
where: north gallery wall at (4,3,2) and (8,3,2) (wall signs facing north)
instruction: Use B.sign('spruce', ['ST. OLAV','STAVKIRKE'], {facing:'north', color:'white', glow:true}) and move each sign out in front of the post line if hidden; keep text exactly.

title: Ridge crest and shingle banding on the tiered roofs
where: tier A and B gable roofs (roof() calls in build.mjs sections 5 and 6)
instruction: Add `ridge: 'crest'` and `pattern: {material:'polished_blackstone', every:3, offset:1}` to the two gable roof() calls, or use a lighter `trim`; rebuild and compare roof tone with mcd palette.

title: Gallery rail detail and corner lanterns
where: gallery posts at (0,3,0), (12,3,0), (0,3,16), (12,3,16) and every 4th post
instruction: Use a fixtures rule via mcd paint (`north rows 0-4 -> fixtures at pilasters`) or B.lantern(false) on a fence top at each corner post; keep the entrance gap open.

title: Weather the stone base
where: all four faces of the base, y=0..1
instruction: mcd paint rules: `all faces ground row -> weather moderate` then `all faces rows 0-1 -> gradient mossy_stone_bricks..stone_bricks up`; check the palette flag for the base.

title: Add side and back openings on the gallery
where: east and west gallery rails, mid-run x=0 / x=12 z=7..9
instruction: Remove the spruce_fence at z=8 on both sides to make a side doorway with a stone step stair at (0,0,8) and (12,0,8) facing outward, and re-run mcd check for walkability.

title: Wall banners on the porch posts
where: entrance posts x=4 and x=8 at z=1, y=3
instruction: B.banner('red', [['border','black'],['cross','yellow']], {facing:'south'}) hung on the inner face of the two porch posts; check they have a solid block behind.

title: Lighten the dark-on-dark eave line
where: gallery roof meeting the nave wall, x=2 and x=10, y=7..8
instruction: Add a spruce_stairs cornice (upside down) along the wall base under the tier-A eave, or set ROOF trim to a lighter stair; re-run mcd palette until the dark-on-dark flag clears.
